reference_definition: best (minimum) recorded lap_time_s among the driver's completed laps with observed_at_s <= T, excluding FastF1-generated synthetic rows; ties resolve to the earliest lap
reference_label: best completed lap so far, LAP n
why_best_so_far: minimum is robust to pit laps (a pit lap can never be the minimum); previous-lap reference would inject pit-lap noise into every delta
excluded_from_reference: fastf1_generated rows (SOURCE_METADATA, causally safe to exclude)

not_excluded_from_reference.deleted_laps: POST_RACE stewards knowledge; excluding would leak the future
not_excluded_from_reference.pit_laps: IN_LAP evidence, shown factually with a Pit lap tag; can never be the minimum
not_excluded_from_reference.sc_vsc_laps: slower by construction; documented limitation, deltas stay descriptive

delta_definition: lap/sector value minus the same field of the reference lap; null when either side missing
delta_language: descriptive only (S1 +0.112 vs best LAP n); no qualitative labels, no causal claims
